response.text:

Ek baat notice ki: message mein "new maintenance charge" ka zikr hai, aur amount QAR 6,500 hai. Aapke pichle rent se yeh zyada ho sakta hai. Confirm kar dijiye:

**QAR 6,500 → Al Noor Rooms (landlord, ****6001)** — bhej du?

"haan" boliye to main abhi bhej dunga.
